personal-dashboard-multi-step-dialog-pro:
Current page indicator for the multi-step dialog.

Parameters:
* $1 - Current page
* $2 - Total pages
personal-dashboard-multi-step-dialog-nex: Text for the “Next” button, which navigates to the next page.
personal-dashboard-multi-step-dialog-pre: Text for the “Previous” button, which navigates to the previous page.
personal-dashboard-multi-step-dialog-got: Text for the “Got it” button, which closes the multi-step dialog.
personal-dashboard-feed-error:
Error message for when the feed fails to load.

Parameters:
* $1 - Unknown error message
personal-dashboard-feed-incomplete: Shown in place of a feed's list when its first page came back empty because a source couldn't be read, as opposed to there being nothing to show.
personal-dashboard-feed-load-more:
Label for the button at the bottom of a feed, which shows more items below the ones already shown. In a card on a narrow viewport, or in a module that does not show more items in place, it opens the module's full list instead.
{{Identical|Show more}}
personal-dashboard-feed-loading-more: Accessible name of a feed's list while the next page of items loads. Screen readers announce it when focus moves to the list, because the progress bar is hidden from them.
personal-dashboard-feed-show-less:
Accessible label for the icon-only button at the bottom of a feed after more items were shown. It hides the extra items again.
{{Identical|Show less}}
